literal_meaning: সংসারের ধর্ম (household duty or family dharma)
figurative_meaning_bn: পুরুষের গার্হস্থ্যজীবন- স্ত্রী-পুত্র নিয়ে লোকালয়ে বসবাস করা
figurative_meaning_en: A man's householder life - living in the world with wife and children
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বয়স হয়েছে, এখন সংসারধর্ম পালন করার সময়।
example_sentences_in_english: He is of age now; it's time to take up householder duties.
Without embracing family life, one's existence feels incomplete.
history: Refers to the grihastha ashrama in Hindu life stages, emphasizing family responsibilities as a religious duty.
note: Rooted in Hindu concepts of dharma, common in Bengali literature and everyday traditional discourse.
